blocks.text: Above the troposphere, the stratosphere lies which is at a distance of 12-50 km above the earth surface. Temperature increases from -58 °C to -2 °C. Stratosphere can also be divided into three regions according to the distribution of ultraviolet radiations from the Sun. Since ozone in the upper layer absorbs high energy ultraviolet radiations from the Sun. It breaks down into monoatomic oxygen and diatomic oxygen.

The middle stratosphere has less ultraviolet radiations passing through it. Here, monoatomic oxygen and diatomic oxygen recombine to form ozone which is an exothermic reaction due to which formation of ozone layer takes place.
The lower stratosphere receives very low ultraviolet radiations, thus monoatomic oxygen is not found here and ozone is not formed here.
